Bettina, I saved the mail draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) with the subject "PHL label cleanup." Nothing has been sent.

The draft has Sofia's bullets from #coastal-team, plus your two lines: Pellucid rows are the Gulf Coast terminal rows, and Pellow rows are the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. I signed it "Sofia and Bettina," so change the sign-off if you'd rather it come from one of you.
